sections.heading: Choosing the Right Glass for Your Burke Commercial Property
sections.body: Selecting the appropriate glass for a commercial window replacement project involves balancing performance, aesthetics, and budget. Insulated glass units with double or triple panes help reduce heat transfer and noise infiltration — both valuable qualities for office environments where comfort and concentration matter. Low-emissivity coatings are a common option that can help moderate interior temperatures by managing solar heat gain. Tempered and laminated glass options offer additional safety characteristics appropriate for ground-level commercial installations. Tinted and reflective glazing can enhance privacy and reduce glare in conference rooms and open office spaces. Our glazing specialists will walk you through available options, explain the trade-offs in plain language, and help you select products that align with your building's function, your tenants' needs, and your long-term property goals without overpromising outcomes we cannot guarantee.
